backfillDescription: Retry registration link creation for machines without a link.
badRequest: Unable to process the request. Check the input and device connection status.
commissionConfirm: Start connecting the physical device using its saved Matter payload. Set the payload in the machine information first. A device that is already connected cannot be connected again.
conflict: A machine with this number, building, gender and type already exists.
copyFailed: Unable to copy. Select and copy the link manually.
deleteConfirm: Deleting this machine also deletes its usage information and power records. This cannot be undone.
editHint: Blank coordinates and Matter payload preserve existing values. Enter a payload only when changing it.
forbidden: You do not have permission to perform this action.
invalidForm: Check the input. Machine numbers and coordinates must be integers.
invalidRange: The end number must be greater than the start number and at most 30.
invalidUser: Enter a valid user UUID. You cannot change your own role.
linksDescription: Check registration links and create missing links for machines.
machinesDescription: Register washers and dryers, manage availability and positions, and connect devices.
name: Name
noRecords: No power records for the selected period.
notFound: Target not found. Refresh the list.
overviewDescription: Check machine status across all laundry rooms. Status updates every 30 seconds.
permissionsDescription: Grant administrator access or change a role back to user.
permissionsHint: Enter the UUID of the target user. The API does not provide user listing or search, so you must know their UUID.
powerDescription: View power measurements for a machine as a chart and chronological list.
powerRangeHint: Leave the start time blank to query the last hour. Set a start time to query all records from that time onward.
rangeHint: Register machines from the start number through the end number. The end number must be greater than the start number and at most 30.
recentRecordsHint: The list shows the latest 100 records. The chart shows all records in the query.
requestFailed: Unable to process the request. Try again shortly.
searchPlaceholder: Search UUID, number or short code
selectMachineHint: Select a machine and time range to view power records.
selfRoleHint: You cannot change your own role. Check the target UUID and role before submitting.
